race.description: Snap Printing Wollongong F&M Mdn Hcp
race.comment: EVANTA (7) well-bred filly resuming. Unwanted in betting on debut and ran accordingly with a tiring seventh in a 2yo Hcp at Eagle Farm over 1000m last December. Has been given ample time to develop and looks ready to go after the two sound trials. Gets her chance from the good draw. HELLO LIZ (9) three-year-old Hello Youmzain filly from Queens Rose on debut for the Archibald camp. Has impressed in both trials and McEvoy sticks after riding her in the two trials. Leading contender. FIABA (8) drifted back on debut and failed to close off with a disappointing seventh over 1100m in a Super Maiden at Canterbury. Improver over the extra trip. SO INSIGHTFUL (11) three-year-old filly by Written Tycoon from Lisdoonvarna on debut for the Amanda Turner stable. Trialled well and gets her chance from the inside barrier.
